prompt: LLVM constrained frem rounding mode argument effect
answer:
The rounding-mode argument of `llvm.experimental.constrained.frem` has no effect on the result: `frem` is never rounded. It is included for consistency with the other constrained floating-point intrinsics.

The argument still must be supplied and may be one of the constrained rounding-mode metadata values, including `round.dynamic`. In general, these arguments control optimizer assumptions; they do not change the runtime floating-point environment.
